template.name: universal-app
template.description: A lean React + Vite starter that grows into anything. A built-in capability router reads what you ask for, then enables the right Rayfin services, installs the right modules, and activates the right skills — CRUD apps, functions, charts, or Fabric analytics dashboards.

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
scripts.test: npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend test && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions test
scripts.schema:sql: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && node scripts/print-schema.mjs

rayfinScriptBases.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
